$Comment: One of the Yeti's later phases: his fight's Phase2Behavior and Phase3Behavior slots both run this,
The first moment the phase sees the Yeti bound in the Boss slot, it raises its flag (ArmedFlag, so
all of this happens once per try), puts Effect on him (none when Effect is empty), raises AddCount
of AddRole around the fight's entity (none when AddRole is empty), moves the music to MusicPhase and
shows every member Moment. Then, for as long as the phase lasts, every Interval seconds a warning
ring lights under each player within VolleyRange of the fight's entity and a snowball falls onto it
(the pack's shared Macro_Orbis_Boss_Volley dropping Interaction). The Yeti keeps fighting as his
role fights the whole time. The Volley names are the volley's own bookkeeping: give each phase its
own, and clear every flag here in Macro_Christmas_Yeti_Reset, so the next try plays them again.

ArmedFlag.Description: The flag that marks this phase's start as played, so it plays once per try.

Effect.Description: The effect put on the Yeti for the rest of the fight. Empty puts none.

AddRole.Description: The creature that rises as the phase starts. Empty raises none.

AddCount.Description: How many of AddRole rise, as a [min, max] range.

MusicPhase.Description: The music's phase as this phase starts: Phase2 or Phase3.

Moment.Description: The FeedbackMoment every member is shown as the phase starts. Empty shows nothing.

Range.Description: How far from the script's entity the Yeti is looked for.

Interval.Description: Seconds between snowball volleys in this phase, as a [min, max] range rolled each time.

Interaction.Description: The snowball each volley drops at a player's feet.

VolleyRange.Description: How far from the script's entity a player may stand and still be a volley's target.

VolleyArmedFlag.Description: The volley's flag set once its interval has started. Give each phase its own name.

VolleyIntervalTimer.Description: The volley's timer holding the wait to the next volley. Give each phase its own name.

VolleyFlag.Description: The volley's flag that starts one volley. Give each phase its own name.

VolleyRunningFlag.Description: The volley's flag marking a volley in progress. Give each phase its own name.

VolleyBurstTimer.Description: The volley's timer holding a volley's length. Give each phase its own name.

VolleyWaveTimer.Description: The volley's timer for point waves, unused here. Give each phase its own name.

VolleyPlayerTimer.Description: The volley's timer pacing the drops on players. Give each phase its own name.

Instructions.$Comment: As the phase starts: the effect, the adds, the music and the news, once.
